title: Body scans, ref cams and football AI: Inside the World Cup's new era
article_content: The New York Times examines how AI is shaping the 2026 World Cup, from body-scanning analytics and AI-assisted refereeing to automated match-tracking systems. The piece discusses pilots underway, potential benefits in decision accuracy and broadcast experience, and the challenges around transparency, bias, and data privacy for players and officials.

title: Meet the WorldTour cycling team who want to use AI to drive their recruitment and performance
article_content: The Times profiles Visma-Lease a Bike, a WorldTour team exploring a partnership with Mistral AI to harness machine learning for training analytics, race strategy, and talent recruitment ahead of the Tour de France. The piece highlights how real-time and historical data can inform rider selection and performance optimization.

title: SBJ Daily: Adobe, MLB expand AI tools; PGA Tour changes on the horizon
article_content: Sports Business Journal reports on the growing adoption of AI across sports, including Adobe's and MLB's expanded AI-powered analytics and fan-engagement tools, and discusses implications for team operations, marketing, and monetization strategies.
